holdout_card.source_page: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building
holdout_card.fact_statement: China Railways Number 10 was part of the joint venture that contracted the Thailand State Audit Office building.
holdout_card.source_span: the contractors were the joint venture between Italian-Thai Development and China Railways Number 10 (Thailand) Co., Ltd.

qa_variants.question: Which foreign-affiliated company was part of the joint venture that contracted the Thailand State Audit Office building prior to its collapse?
qa_variants.source_span: the contractors were the joint venture between Italian-Thai Development and China Railways Number 10 (Thailand) Co., Ltd.
